title: WPSS/1699/2026 of ALIYA SAIFI Vs STATE OF UTTARAKHAND

HIGH COURT OF UTTARAKHAND AT NAINITAL
Writ Petition Service Single No.1699 of 2026
07th July, 2026
Aliya Saifi .........Petitioner
Versus
State of Uttarakhand and others ......Respondents
----------------------------------------------------------------------
Presence:-
Mr. Hari Mohan Bhatia, learned counsel for the petitioner.
Mr. N.S. Pundir, learned D.A.G. for the State.
----------------------------------------------------------------------
Hon'ble Pankaj Purohit, J.
By means of this writ petition, the petitioner has
challenged the order dated 02.07.2026, which has wrongly
been transcribed as 02.07.2027, annexure no.6 to the writ
petition, whereby attachment of the petitioner at G.G.I.C.
Bhimtal has been cancelled pursuant to the order dated
19.06.2026 passed by respondent no.2-Director General,
School Education, Uttarakhand.
2. Facts of the case, as culled out from the writ
petition in short, are that the petitioner was initially posted
at G.G.I.C. Dwarahat, Almora, on the post of Lecturer
(Chemistry). Vide order dated 17.03.2026, passed by
respondent no.2-Director General, School Education,
Uttarakhand, the petitioner was attached in G.G.I.C.
Bhimtal on her request. Subsequently respondent no.2-
Director General, School Education has cancelled all the
attachments and pursuant to cancellation of her
attachment order, she was sent back to her original place
of posting at G.G.I.C. Dwarahat, Almora vide order
impugned in the writ petition.
3. Petitioner has challenged her relieving without
challenging the cancellation order as well as the G.O.
whereby the attachment was cancelled.

4. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that
she has got some family problems, therefore, she cannot be
sent back to her original place of posting i.e., G.G.I.C.
Dwarahat, Almora.
5. Learned counsel for the petitioner further
submits that she wants to be posted at a remote (durgam)
place and since she has been posted in Dwarahat for the
last seven years, therefore, she wants to be transferred at a
remote (durgam) place by the respondent-Authorities.
6. Without interfering in the order of relieving, the
writ petition stands disposed of with a liberty to the
petitioner to move a representation for transferring her
from Dwarahat to any other remote place, to the
respondent no.3-Director, Secondary Education, within a
period of ten days from today. If such a representation is
moved by the petitioner, respondent no.3-Director,
Secondary Education shall decide the same within a period
of one month, in accordance with law.
(Pankaj Purohit, J.)
